questions.question: What is the primary objective of implementing instruction pipelining in a CPU?
options: To increase the clock frequency of the processor.
To reduce the overall power consumption of the CPU.
To execute multiple instructions concurrently, thereby improving throughput.
To enable out-of-order execution for dependent instructions.
To minimize the memory access latency.

questions.question: In modern digital integrated circuits, total power consumption is typically divided into two main categories: static power and dynamic power. Which of the following is the primary contributor to dynamic power consumption?
options: Leakage currents through transistors when they are theoretically "off".
Short-circuit current during transistor switching.
Subthreshold leakage current.
Capacitive charging and discharging during logic transitions.
Punch-through currents in short-channel devices.

questions.question: In the physical design stage of an Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC), what is the primary goal of the "Placement and Routing" (P&R) phase?
options: To verify the functional correctness of the RTL design against specifications.
To synthesize the RTL code into a gate-level netlist.
To physically arrange standard cells and macros on the chip area and connect them with interconnect wires.
To perform detailed timing analysis and generate timing reports.
To convert the gate-level netlist into a manufacturing mask database (GDSII).

questions.question: Which principle of computer architecture states that programs tend to access data and instructions that are spatially or temporally close to those they have recently accessed? This principle is fundamental to the effectiveness of caching.
options: Amdahl's Law
Principle of Spatial Locality
Principle of Temporal Locality
Principle of Least Recently Used (LRU)
Both Principle of Spatial Locality and Principle of Temporal Locality

questions.question: In Hardware Description Languages (HDLs) like Verilog or VHDL, which design style primarily describes the circuit's operation by specifying its functionality using high-level constructs (e.g., if-else, case statements, arithmetic operations) without explicitly instantiating gates or modules?
options: Gate-level modeling
Dataflow modeling
Behavioral modeling
Structural modeling
Switch-level modeling
